title: Block (2 parts)
spec:
Create a new coordinate system for the first part by setting the Euler angles to zero degrees and the translation vector to [0.5171, 0.618, 0.0]. Draw the first face of the two-dimensional sketch, which consists of a single loop made up of four lines. The first line starts at the origin (0.0, 0.0) and ends at (0.2173, 0.0). The second line extends from (0.2173, 0.0) to (0.2173, 0.0802). The third line runs from (0.2173, 0.0802) to (0.0, 0.0802), and the fourth line completes the rectangle by going from (0.0, 0.0802) back to the origin. Apply a scale factor of 0.2173 to the entire sketch. Transform the scaled two-dimensional sketch into three dimensions by rotating it with Euler angles set to zero degrees and translating it using the vector [0.5171, 0.618, 0.0]. Extrude the sketch along the normal direction by 0.0508 units without extruding in the opposite direction. This process creates a new solid body, resulting in a rectangular block with a flat top and bottom and four straight edges. The dimensions of the block are length = 0.21726779886008082, width = 0.0802063369623663, and height = 0.050763504406560946.

For the second part, create another new coordinate system with Euler angles set to zero degrees and a translation vector of [0.4419, 0.618, 0.0]. Draw the first face of the two-dimensional sketch, which consists of a single loop made up of six lines. The first line starts at the origin (0.0, 0.0) and ends at (0.0751, 0.0). The second line extends from (0.0751, 0.0) to (0.0751, 0.0802). The third line runs from (0.0751, 0.0802) to (0.2924, 0.0802), and the fourth line continues from (0.2924, 0.0802) to (0.2924, 0.132). The fifth line goes from (0.2924, 0.132) to (0.0, 0.132), and the sixth line completes the L-shape by returning from (0.0, 0.132) to the origin. Apply a scale factor of 0.2924 to the entire sketch. Transform the scaled two-dimensional sketch into three dimensions by rotating it with Euler angles set to zero degrees and translating it using the vector [0.4419, 0.618, 0.0]. Extrude the sketch along the normal direction by 0.0254 units without extruding in the opposite direction. Add this part to the existing body, resulting in an L-shaped CAD model with a rectangular base and a vertical extension. The dimensions of the L-shaped model are length = 0.292397785381791, width = 0.1319851114570585, and height = 0.025381752203280473.

reference.code:
import cadquery as cq

# Define the first part (rectangular block)
part_1 = (
    cq.Workplane("XY")
    .moveTo(0.0, 0.0)
    .lineTo(0.2173, 0.0)
    .lineTo(0.2173, 0.0802)
    .lineTo(0.0, 0.0802)
    .close()
    .extrude(0.0508)
    .translate((0.5171, 0.618, 0.0))
)

# Define the second part (L-shaped extension)
part_2 = (
    cq.Workplane("XY")
    .moveTo(0.0, 0.0)
    .lineTo(0.0751, 0.0)
    .lineTo(0.0751, 0.0802)
    .lineTo(0.2924, 0.0802)
    .lineTo(0.2924, 0.132)
    .lineTo(0.0, 0.132)
    .close()
    .extrude(0.0254)
    .translate((0.4419, 0.618, 0.0))
)

# Combine the two parts
r = part_1.union(part_2)

lanes.code:
import cadquery as cq

# Overall dimensions
L = 0.2925   # X
W = 0.1320   # Y
H = 0.0508   # Z

# Base plate (full footprint, lower height)
plate_t = 0.0264
x_start = 0.0759   # where the raised block begins in X
y_start = 0.0515   # where the raised block begins in Y (block at back)

# Base plate
plate = cq.Workplane("XY").box(L, W, plate_t, centered=False)

# Raised block on top (from x_start to L, y_start to W, up to full height)
block = (cq.Workplane("XY", origin=(x_start, y_start, plate_t))
         .box(L - x_start, W - y_start, H - plate_t, centered=False))

r = plate.union(block)

lanes.code:
import cadquery as cq

# Lower base slab: full footprint (X x Y), half the total height
base = (
    cq.Workplane("XY")
    .box(0.2925, 0.1320, 0.0254, centered=(False, False, False))
)

# Upper block: sits on top of the base, covering the right portion in X
# and the front portion in Y, bringing total height to 0.0508
upper = (
    cq.Workplane("XY")
    .box(0.2925 - 0.0762, 0.0762, 0.0254, centered=(False, False, False))
    .translate((0.0762, 0.0, 0.0254))
)

# Union the two bodies into the final stepped part
r = base.union(upper)
